# relay_private_endpoint_service (Data Source)

Reads a workspace's private endpoint service by ID or by cloud and region, with the endpoints registered on it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_private_endpoint_service" "use1" {
  workspace_id = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
  cloud        = "aws"
  region       = "us-east-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in.

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider. Set together with `region`.
- `id` (String) Service ID.
- `region` (String) Cloud region. Set together with `cloud`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `endpoint_service_name` (String) AWS VPC endpoint service name.
- `endpoints` (Attributes List) Endpoints registered on the service, in index order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `error_message` (String) Why the service failed, when it did.
- `status` (String) `INITIATING`, `AVAILABLE`, `FAILED` or `DELETING`.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `connection_status` (String) Connection status.
- `dns_name` (String) DNS name the endpoint's hostnames point at.
- `error_message` (String) Why the connection failed, when it did.
- `id` (String) Endpoint ID.
- `index` (Number) Index in the endpoint's hostnames.
- `vpc_endpoint_id` (String) AWS interface VPC endpoint ID.
